craft_evidence.owned: No owned facility found. Evidence: brand's supply-chain disclosure describes 'contract factories' and publishes no supplier list; 2020 S-1 names Vietnam and India as primary countries of origin and describes third-party suppliers, no owned plants.
craft_evidence.makers: None named on 69 product pages read (outerwear 53 listings, golf apparel 14 styles, 2 loafers).
craft_evidence.mills: None named. Claim only: leather sourced 'majority' from BLC medal-rated tanneries (tanneries unnamed), supply-chain disclosure page.
craft_evidence.heritage: Dated, not placed, by the brand: about-us 'since 1928' (claim). Founders Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan per 2020 S-1; place Chicago per Chicago History Museum, not the brand.
craft_evidence.process: No. Product pages name comfort technologies (FlexCraft, FlowerFoam 'minimum of 25% natural dandelion rubber', Grand 36Ø 'over 30 innovative features') but no making process.
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page read says only 'Imported' with no country, maker or mill; the brand describes contract factories and names none. The only checkable facts are the 1928 date and an unnamed BLC-rated-tannery leather claim; borderline 2 at most.

ownership.owner: Apax Partners funds (acquired from Nike, completed Feb 2013). No later sale found in 2026-10-10 search; Apax all-investments list carries Cole Haan without stat
